sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·朗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 即使是在我还在夜店打碟的黑胶唱片时代，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 每晚你都要带着300件最珍贵的宝贝去工作，把DJ台变成一个充满50年历史精美文物的流动快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼出品的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, The Times reports that the House Republican in charge of investigating President Trump's ties to Russia was given secret reports by two officials from the Trump White House.
sentences.zh: 今天，《时报》报道称，负责调查特朗普总统与俄罗斯关系的共和党众议员，收到了来自特朗普白宫两名官员提供的秘密报告。

sentences.en: And they call numbers at random, waiting to hear a woman's voice, why young men in India are intentionally dialing wrong numbers.
sentences.zh: 他们随机拨打号码，等待着听到女性的声音。为什么印度的年轻男性会故意拨打错号？

sentences.en: It's Friday, March 31St.
sentences.zh: 今天是3月31日，星期五。

sentences.en: It's the latest twist in a bizarre Washington drama that began on the night of March 21st, 10 days ago.
sentences.zh: 这是华盛顿一场离奇闹剧的最新转折，而这场闹剧始于10天前的3月21日晚。

sentences.en: Representative Devin Nunes, a Republican from California, was riding across town in an Uber when he got a call and diverted to the White House.
sentences.zh: 来自加利福尼亚州的共和党众议员德文·努内斯当时正乘优步穿过城市，接到一个电话后便改道去了白宫。

sentences.en: And his explanation for meeting his source of the White House was that he needed to use one of the secure facilities where you can legally view classified information.
sentences.zh: 他解释说，去白宫见消息源是因为他需要使用那些可以合法查阅机密信息的安全设施。

sentences.en: They're called SCIFs.
sentences.zh: 这些设施被称为SCIF（敏感间歇信息隔离设施）。

sentences.en: My colleague Matt Rosenberg is tracking this story.
sentences.zh: 我的同事马特·罗森伯格正在跟进这个报道。

sentences.en: It's not a watertight story because there are SCIFs at the Capitol.
sentences.zh: 这个说法站不住脚，因为国会大厦里就有SCIF。

sentences.en: There are SCIFs all over Washington.
sentences.zh: 华盛顿到处都是SCIF。

sentences.en: So why was he meeting this guy at the White House?
sentences.zh: 那么他为什么要在那个人那里，在白宫见面呢？

sentences.en: And it's not exactly like a congressman can just show up at the White House late at night and say, hey, I'm Rep Nunes.
sentences.zh: 而且国会议员也不能随随便便在深夜出现在白宫，说：“嘿，我是努内斯议员。”

sentences.en: This is like Jim from the NSA.
sentences.zh: “这是国安局的吉姆。”

sentences.en: And we just got to use one of your SCIFs.
sentences.zh: “我们得借用你们的一个SCIF。”

sentences.en: I mean, that's what his story would have you believe.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他的故事想让你相信的就是这些。

sentences.en: And that's kind of fantastical.
sentences.zh: 这简直太离谱了。

sentences.en: This is how Nunes would soon describe what he learned that night.
sentences.zh: 这就是努内斯后来描述他当晚所获信息的方式。

sentences.en: I recently confirmed that on numerous occasions, the intelligence community incidentally collected information about U.S.
sentences.zh: 我最近证实，情报界曾多次附带收集了有关美国公民的信息，

sentences.en: citizens involved in the Trump transition.
sentences.zh: 这些公民涉及特朗普的过渡团队。

sentences.en: Details about U.S.
sentences.zh: 关于与新政府有关联的美国人的细节，

sentences.en: persons associated with the incoming administration, details with little or no apparent foreign intelligence value were widely disseminated in intelligence community reporting.
sentences.zh: 那些几乎没有或根本没有明显外国情报价值的细节，在情报界的报告中被广泛传播。

sentences.en: I saw intelligence reports that the Trump people were swept up into American surveillance.
sentences.zh: 我看到的情报报告显示，特朗普团队的人被卷入了美国的监控之中。

sentences.en: And it's really bizarre because he's confusing.
sentences.zh: 这真的很奇怪，因为他让人困惑。

sentences.en: He's kind of contradicting himself a little bit.
sentences.zh: 他有点自相矛盾。

sentences.en: He's saying, you know, this doesn't this actually doesn't back up Trump's wiretapping claims, but that it sort of does.
sentences.zh: 他一方面说，这实际上并不能支持特朗普关于被窃听的说法，但又说这在某种程度上确实支持了。

sentences.en: President Trump seized on the information, saying it validated his recent claims that he'd been wiretapped by President Obama, a claim that had been received like this.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统抓住了这些信息，称其证实了他最近关于被奥巴马总统窃听的指控，而这一指控此前是这样被回应的：

sentences.en: With respect to the president's tweets about alleged wiretapping directed at him by the prior administration.
sentences.zh: 关于总统在推特上指控前任政府对他进行窃听一事，

sentences.en: From Democrats, Republicans and members of the intelligence community.
sentences.zh: 来自民主党人、共和党人以及情报界成员的反应是：

sentences.en: I have no information that supports those tweets.
sentences.zh: “我没有任何信息支持这些推文。”

sentences.en: And we have looked carefully inside the FBI.
sentences.zh: “我们已经在联邦调查局内部进行了仔细核查。”

sentences.en: There was great interest in where Nunes had gotten this information.
sentences.zh: 人们非常关心努内斯是从哪里得到这些信息的。

sentences.en: Because to make matters more complicated, Nunes leads a House committee charged with investigating President Trump on another matter, his campaign ties to Russia.
sentences.zh: 因为更复杂的是，努内斯领导着众议院的一个委员会，该委员会负责调查特朗普总统的另一件事，即他的竞选团队与俄罗斯的关系。

sentences.en: Now, Matt Rosenberg is reporting the identity of the sources who provided that information to Nunes.
sentences.zh: 现在，马特·罗森伯格正在报道向努内斯提供这些信息的来源身份。

sentences.en: They are two members of the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 他们是特朗普政府的两名成员。

sentences.en: Now we know on the night of the 21st, he got a call, ran over to the White House and an official there named Mike Ellis.
sentences.zh: 我们现在知道，在21日那天晚上，他接到一个电话，跑到了白宫，那里的一位名叫迈克·埃利斯的官员，

sentences.en: He's a lawyer who's in the counsel's office, allowed Mr. Nunes to review the intelligence.
sentences.zh: 他是法律顾问办公室的一名律师，允许努内斯先生查阅了这些情报。

sentences.en: But it wasn't Ellis who found the information.
sentences.zh: 但发现这些信息的并不是埃利斯。

sentences.en: What we're told by a lot of different sources is that the information was found by a guy named Ezra Cohen-Watkin.
sentences.zh: 我们从许多不同渠道获悉，这些信息是由一个名叫埃兹拉·科恩-沃特金的人发现的。

sentences.en: He is a former defense intelligence agency official who was brought into the NSC as the senior director for intelligence by Michael Flynn,
sentences.zh: 他曾是国防情报局的官员，由迈克尔·弗林带入国家安全委员会担任情报高级主任，

sentences.en: the former national security advisor who was fired in February.
sentences.zh: 而弗林是二月份被解职的前国家安全顾问。

sentences.en: A few weeks ago, National Security Advisor, H.R.
sentences.zh: 几周前，国家安全顾问H.R.麦克马斯特曾试图解雇科恩-沃特金先生，

sentences.en: McMaster, tried to fire Mr. Cohen-Watkin, saying he was in over his head.
sentences.zh: 称他无法胜任这份工作。

sentences.en: And his job was then saved by Steve Bannon and Jared Kushner.
sentences.zh: 但他的工作后来被史蒂夫·班农和贾里德·库什纳保住了。

sentences.en: They saved his job.
sentences.zh: 他们保住了他的职位。

sentences.en: So to be clear, Matt, what you're saying is that these were two officials in the Trump White House who shared this intelligence with Nunes.
sentences.zh: 所以说清楚点，马特，你的意思是这两名特朗普白宫的官员与努内斯分享了这些情报。

sentences.en: What does that tell us about how close Nunes is to the president and this White House?
sentences.zh: 这说明努内斯与总统及本届白宫的关系有多亲密？

sentences.en: Well, there's another detail here, too, is that we've got one official telling us who has firsthand knowledge of this,
sentences.zh: 嗯，这里还有一个细节，我们有一位对此有第一手了解的官员告诉我们，

sentences.en: telling us that Mr. Cohen-Watkins began his search for this intelligence after Trump made his tweets about being wiretap by the Obama administration.
sentences.zh: 科恩-沃特金先生是在特朗普发推文称被奥巴马政府窃听后，才开始搜寻这些情报的。

sentences.en: And this was part of an effort to find a post facto justification for those tweets.
sentences.zh: 这是为了给那些推文寻找事后辩解理由的努力的一部分。

sentences.en: And so I think this tells us a lot here.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这说明了很多问题。

sentences.en: You know,
sentences.zh: 你知道，

sentences.en: Mr. Nunes has at various times in the last few months been used by the White House as a surrogate to call reporters and kind of push back on various stories about the Russia stuff.
sentences.zh: 努内斯先生在过去几个月里曾多次被白宫当作代理人，去给记者打电话，试图反驳各种关于俄罗斯问题的报道。

sentences.en: I mean, it looks even worse, though.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这看起来更糟糕了。

sentences.en: It's not just about who Nunes got the information from that night.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是谁在那个晚上给了努内斯信息的问题。

sentences.en: It's what he did with it the next day.
sentences.zh: 而是他第二天用这些信息做了什么。

sentences.en: Nunes makes this briefing at the Capitol, kind of hastily arranged news conference.
sentences.zh: 努内斯在国会大厦进行了简报，那是一场仓促安排的新闻发布会。

sentences.en: Then he runs off to the White House to brief Trump, saying the president had to know,
sentences.zh: 然后他跑去白宫向特朗普汇报，说总统必须知道这些，

sentences.en: even though the president is the subject of the House Russian investigation that Nunes is supposed to be leading.
sentences.zh: 尽管总统正是努内斯本应领导的众议院俄罗斯调查的对象。

sentences.en: And then the White House driveway outside gives some more comments.
sentences.zh: 然后他在白宫车道外又发表了一些评论。

sentences.en: Let us get all the reports.
sentences.zh: “让我们获取所有的报告。”

sentences.en: It is it is possible.
sentences.zh: “这是……这是可能的。”

sentences.en: And he does this all before he briefs anyone in the Intelligence Committee.
sentences.zh: 而且他做这一切之前，都没有向情报委员会的任何人通报。

sentences.en: That committee is normally very collegial.
sentences.zh: 那个委员会通常是非常团结的。

sentences.en: And what's standard is you share information with the committee before you run to the White House with it.
sentences.zh: 标准做法是在你跑去白宫之前，先与委员会分享信息。

sentences.en: At this point, Matt, can Congressman Nunes lead an impartial investigation into the ties between the Trump campaign and Russia, which is his job?
sentences.zh: 马特，在这一点上，努内斯议员还能对特朗普竞选团队与俄罗斯之间的关系进行公正的调查吗？这可是他的职责。

sentences.en: He is the chairman of this very sensitive Intelligence Committee.
sentences.zh: 他是这个极其敏感的情报委员会的主席。

sentences.en: It certainly doesn't look that way.
sentences.zh: 看起来肯定不像。

sentences.en: The Democrats absolutely say, no, he cannot.
sentences.zh: 民主党人绝对说不，他不能。

sentences.en: They've called for him to recuse himself.
sentences.zh: 他们已经要求他回避。

sentences.en: You cannot have the person in charge of an impartial investigation be partial to one side.
sentences.zh: 你不能让一个负责公正调查的人对一方有偏袒。

sentences.en: It's an inherent contradiction.
sentences.zh: 这本身就是一种内在的矛盾。

sentences.en: Some Republicans have joined in that call.
sentences.zh: 一些共和党人也加入了这一呼吁。

sentences.en: So far, he's kind of dismissed it.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，他基本上不予理会。

sentences.en: And Ryan, Paul Ryan, the Speaker of the House, has resisted those calls.
sentences.zh: 而众议院议长保罗·瑞安也抵制了这些要求。

sentences.en: But, you know, there seems to be no confidence on the Democratic side.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，民主党方面似乎已经完全失去了信心。

sentences.en: Some Republicans are peeling away as well.
sentences.zh: 一些共和党人也开始动摇了。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Matthew, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 马修，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: I know it's a busy day.
sentences.zh: 我知道今天很忙。

sentences.en: Sorry I'm rushing out so much, man.
sentences.zh: 抱歉我走得这么匆忙，伙计。

sentences.en: I hope that was helpful.
sentences.zh: 希望这些有帮助。

sentences.en: It was.
sentences.zh: 非常有帮助。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Great.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的DealBook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最有影响力的人物，包括J.D.万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、泽兰·蒙达尼等等。

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zeran Mondani, and many others live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话实况。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 我们将对部分采访进行直播，供大家在11月18日于NYTimes.com免费观看。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at NYTimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得一个月的免费访问权限，阅读我们所有的报道。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 艾伦·贝里为我们带来了一个关于印度科技、浪漫以及一种被称为“电话罗密欧”的日益增长趋势的故事。

sentences.en: Ellen Berry brought us a story from India about technology, romance, and a growing trend called phone Romeos.
sentences.zh: 那么，带我们走进印度勒克瑙的这个呼叫中心吧。

sentences.en: So take us inside this call center in Lucknow, India.
sentences.zh: 描述一下现场。

sentences.en: Describe the scene.
sentences.zh: 在这个呼叫中心，实际上是一个警察呼叫中心，有大约两打主要由女性组成的工作人员，她们整天都在接听几乎从未间断的电话。

sentences.en: So in this call center, which is actually a police call center, there are banks of about two dozen, mostly women, taking calls that basically never stop coming all day.
sentences.zh: 这些电话性质统一，都是来自那些一直受到骚扰电话困扰的女性，通常是男性打来的持续不断的重复电话。

sentences.en: And the calls are of a uniform nature, which is they are calls from women who have been getting harassing phone calls, often persistent repeating phone calls from men.
sentences.zh: 他们寻找性、寻找爱，或者寻找浪漫。

sentences.en: Who are looking for sex, looking for love, or looking for romance.
sentences.zh: 每个国家都有恶作剧电话。

sentences.en: Every country has crank calls.
sentences.zh: 但我认为印度目前的情况有趣之处在于，越来越多的男性只是一个接一个地拨打号码，寻找可以交谈的女性。

sentences.en: But I think what is interesting about what is going on in India is that there are increasingly guys who just dial numbers one after the other looking for a woman to talk to.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，在某些情况下，当他们听到女性的声音时，他们就会反复拨打。

sentences.en: And I think when they, in some cases, when they hear a female voice, they just try calling again and again.
sentences.zh: “您拨打的号码正在通话中。”

sentences.en: Dial Kia who are numbered.
sentences.zh: “请稍后再拨。”

sentences.en: The number you have dialed is currently busy.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一种电话跟踪。

sentences.en: Please try again later.
sentences.zh: 如果你和年轻女性交谈，会发现这非常普遍。

sentences.en: So this is a kind of a phone stalking.
sentences.zh: “天哪。”

sentences.en: And it is remarkably common if you talk to young women.
sentences.zh: “我想我每天大概会接到三个这样的电话。”

sentences.en: Oh my God.
I think I get like three calls every day.
sentences.zh: 基蒂卡·查克拉瓦蒂是印度勒克瑙的一名25岁女性。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: “他们只是漫无目的地打电话，比如：‘嗨，你是谁？’或者‘嗨，我想认识你。’

sentences.en: Kitika Chakravarti is a 25 year old in Lucknow, India.
sentences.zh: 现在我已经对此有点麻木了。

sentences.en: They just call aimlessly like, hi, who is this?
sentences.zh: 现在只要他们说‘喂’，我就直接挂断并拉黑号码。

sentences.en: Or hi, I want to get to know you.
sentences.zh: 我自动就知道我不应该接这个电话。

sentences.en: Now it becomes sort of numb to it.
sentences.zh: 但最初几次我有点心烦，因为有一个男人非常执着，他不停地给我打电话说：‘嘿，基蒂卡，我想认识你。’

sentences.en: Now I just block the numbers as soon as they say hello.
sentences.zh: ‘你好吗？’

sentences.en: I just know automatically I shouldn't be answering this call.
sentences.zh: 就像跟我聊天一样，好像他真的认识我似的。

sentences.en: But the first couple of times I was a little upset because there was this one man who was very persistent and he kept calling me and saying, hey Kitika, I want to get to know you.
sentences.zh: 我就说：‘你能别再给我打电话了吗？’

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: ‘否则我可能不得不报警了。’

sentences.en: Like making conversation with me as if he actually knew me.
sentences.zh: 这并没有阻止他。

sentences.en: And I was just like, can you please stop calling me?
sentences.zh: 于是他换了其他号码打过来。

sentences.en: Otherwise I'm probably going to have to report you to police.
sentences.zh: 每天有多少电话打到这些警察呼叫中心投诉这些事？

sentences.en: That didn't deter him.
sentences.zh: 我访问时，每天大约有700个。

sentences.en: So he called from other numbers.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: How many calls to these police call centers are being made every day complaining about these?
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So right now when I visited, it was about 700 a day.
sentences.zh: 负责该行动的警官说，随着手机的普及，投诉量基本上呈指数级增长。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 而且印度目前的增长非常迅速。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 它比中国发展得快得多。

sentences.en: And so what the police commander in charge of the operation says is that it's basically increasing exponentially in line with the penetration of cell phones.
sentences.zh: 在印度，通话费用几乎是免费的。

sentences.en: And there is pretty rapid growth in India.
sentences.zh: 你现在可以用大约14美元买到一部二手手机。

sentences.en: It's moving a lot faster than China, for example.
sentences.zh: SIM卡只要100卢比，不到2美元。

sentences.en: So call minutes are practically free in India.
sentences.zh: 所以手机这种技术确实正在重塑印度的一些社会结构。

sentences.en: And you can now get a used cell phone for, I don't know, $14.
sentences.zh: 印度是一个许多人，尤其是那些不住在城市里的人，仍然生活在相当严格的性别隔离中的国家，

sentences.en: SIM cards cost 100 rupees, which is less than $2.
sentences.zh: 因此在许多情况下，特别是在该国北部，

sentences.en: So this technology of the cell phone is really kind of rewiring some of the social structures in India.
sentences.zh: 年轻男性在成年之前都没有机会与直系亲属以外的女性进行交谈。

sentences.en: India is a country in which many people, especially those not living in the cities, still live with
sentences.zh: 艾伦，你知道这在印度社会是如何成为一种现象的吗？

sentences.en: pretty strict gender segregation so that in many cases, particularly, I guess, in the north
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这里一直存在很多所谓的“夏娃挑逗”。

sentences.en: of the country, you have young men who reach adulthood without having a conversation with a woman outside their immediate family.
sentences.zh: “夏娃挑逗”。

sentences.en: Do you know, Alan, how this became a phenomenon in Indian society?
sentences.zh: 听起来很无辜，甚至有点古怪。

sentences.en: I mean, there's always been a lot of what they call here eve-teasing.
sentences.zh: 但这个词指的是一种常见的针对女性的骚扰形式，通常带有性意味。

sentences.en: Eve-teasing.
sentences.zh: 而“夏娃挑逗”传统的运作方式是……

sentences.en: It sounds innocent enough, even a little quirky.
sentences.zh: 男人们在集市上闲逛，然后……

sentences.en: But the term refers to a common form of harassment of women, often sexual in nature.
sentences.zh: （注：此处原文编号缺失，根据逻辑补全）

sentences.en: And the way eve-teasing sort of traditionally would work is...
sentences.zh: （注：此处原文编号缺失，根据逻辑补全）

sentences.en: Guys hanging out at the marketplace and...
sentences.zh: （注：此处原文编号缺失，根据逻辑补全）

sentences.en: ...spotting the girl and following her around.
sentences.zh: ……发现那个女孩并尾随她。

sentences.en: And just tracing her wherever she goes and talking to her and getting kind of insistent about her responding.
sentences.zh: 无论她去哪儿都跟着她，跟她搭话，还非要她回应不可。

sentences.en: Go!
sentences.zh: 开始！

sentences.en: This is a theme that is just repeated over and over.
sentences.zh: 这是一个被反复提及的主题。

sentences.en: I love you.
sentences.zh: 我爱你。

sentences.en: What's your fear?
sentences.zh: 你害怕什么？

sentences.en: That somehow romances often begin with a man spotting a girl who's unwilling to engage and persisting.
sentences.zh: 某种程度上，浪漫往往始于一个男人发现了一个不愿理睬他的女孩，然后死缠烂打。

sentences.en: I thought it was so much.
sentences.zh: 我以为这没什么大不了的。

sentences.en: Persisting for long enough that she relents.
sentences.zh: 一直纠缠到她妥协为止。

sentences.en: Give me a name.
sentences.zh: 告诉我一个名字。

sentences.en: If you're going to eat, we'll tell you later.
sentences.zh: 如果你要吃饭，我们待会儿再告诉你。

sentences.en: And this is the kind of the mating dance of Bollywood, in a way.
sentences.zh: 在某种意义上，这就是宝莱坞式的求偶舞。

sentences.en: So it kind of lodges into the sort of cultural understanding that girls say no three times
sentences.zh: 所以这在某种程度上植根于一种文化认知，即女孩拒绝三次

sentences.en: or five times, and then very happily relent, which I think just sort of sets the table for all kinds of really awful harassment.
sentences.zh: 或五次，然后非常开心地妥协，我认为这为各种极其恶劣的骚扰铺平了道路。

sentences.en: Yeah, I feel like, I don't know how many people are going to take offense to this, but I feel like Indian men don't, or men, I don't know, they don't deal with rejection very
sentences.zh: 是的，我觉得，我不知道有多少人会对此感到冒犯，但我觉得印度男人，或者说男人，我不知道，他们处理拒绝的方式不太

sentences.en: well, which is why they're very persistent.
sentences.zh: 好，这就是为什么他们非常执着。

sentences.en: No, the word no, I guess, does not mean a lot to these kind of people who actually get a kick out of calling girls like me or other women.
sentences.zh: 不，我想“不”这个词，对那些以骚扰像我这样的女孩或其他女性为乐的人来说，并没有多大意义。

sentences.en: India is a country that is really very obsessed with romance, as you can certainly tell from its filMs.
sentences.zh: 印度是一个非常痴迷于浪漫的国家，这一点从它的电影中就能看出来。

sentences.en: You know, the newspapers are full of crimes of passion, and obviously, passion is kind of instructed to children as a positive attribute.
sentences.zh: 你知道，报纸上充斥着因爱生恨的犯罪报道，显然，孩子们被教导将激情视为一种积极的品质。

sentences.en: It's in the literature, it's in the Hindu epics, it's carved onto the sides of temples.
sentences.zh: 它存在于文学作品中，存在于印度史诗中，还被雕刻在寺庙的侧壁上。

sentences.en: So there's really such a paradox that this is a country where unmarried young men and women are not supposed to know each other.
sentences.zh: 所以这确实是一个悖论，因为在这个国家，未婚的年轻男女本不应该互相认识。

sentences.en: But then love is really at the center of the culture in so many ways.
sentences.zh: 但爱在很多方面确实处于这种文化的核心。

sentences.en: So officially, there are no boyfriends and girlfriends in a conservative society of that kind.
sentences.zh: 因此，在这样一个保守的社会里，官方是不承认有男朋友和女朋友的。

sentences.en: And unofficially, there's a lot of workarounds.
sentences.zh: 但在非官方层面，有很多变通方法。

sentences.en: And to my surprise, I discovered that there was an anthropologist who has written a scholarly paper on this phenomenon in Bangladesh.
sentences.zh: 令我惊讶的是，我发现有一位人类学家写了一篇关于孟加拉国这种现象的学术论文。

sentences.en: And she had a very interesting view of it, because she, among the garment workers that she was working with, she said some of them had five or six telephonic relationships with
sentences.zh: 她对此有非常有趣的看法，因为在她共事的制衣女工中，她说有些人同时维持着五六段电话关系，

sentences.en: men that they would kind of juggle and carry on simultaneously.
sentences.zh: 她们会周旋于这些男人之间，同时进行。

sentences.en: And that for young women who have been basically forbidden any association with men, that there
sentences.zh: 对于那些基本上被禁止与男性交往的年轻女性来说，这种特殊的关系

sentences.en: was something rather advantageous about this particular kind of relationship, because there was physical distance sort of presumed, which gave them much more protection and ability
sentences.zh: 反而有一些优势，因为这种关系预设了物理距离，这给了她们更多的保护和能力

sentences.en: to set limits.
sentences.zh: 来设定界限。

sentences.en: But also, she said, because this kind of relationship, which is only over the phone, requires these young
sentences.zh: 但她也说，因为这种仅通过电话维持的关系，要求这些年轻

sentences.en: men to listen to them for long periods of time, which was something that these young women had never experienced, having a man who listened to them talk.
sentences.zh: 男性长时间倾听她们说话，这是这些年轻女性从未体验过的，即有一个男人愿意听她们倾诉。

sentences.en: Ellen, that research you cited was conducted in Bangladesh.
sentences.zh: 艾伦，你引用的那项研究是在孟加拉国进行的。

sentences.en: So I wonder if you're starting to see evidence that despite all of the anxieties and menace that
sentences.zh: 所以我很好奇，你是否开始看到证据表明，尽管这些陌生男人的电话带来了所有的焦虑和威胁，

sentences.en: these phone calls from random men represent, that some percentage of the women who receive the calls find them welcoming.
sentences.zh: 但仍有一定比例的女性觉得这些电话是受欢迎的。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's pretty clear.
sentences.zh: 是的，这很清楚。

sentences.en: And it's happening in lots of different countries.
sentences.zh: 而且这种情况在许多不同的国家都在发生。

sentences.en: And since this story ran, I've heard from quite a few people from different parts of the world telling me that, you know, oh, well, this happens all over the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 自从这个报道播出以来，我从世界各地听到了不少人的反馈，他们告诉我，哦，这在中东到处都在发生。

sentences.en: It happens when a person from Iran wrote to me to say, I know three couples who got together this way.
sentences.zh: 甚至有一个伊朗人写信给我说，我知道有三对情侣就是这样走到一起的。

sentences.en: Apparently, in Kenya, it's so common that the number one downloaded app is an app to block phone Romeos.
sentences.zh: 显然，在肯尼亚，这种情况非常普遍，以至于下载量排名第一的应用程序就是拦截“电话罗密欧”的软件。

sentences.en: So when you create access in a very restrictive society, all kinds of things happen, good things and bad things.
sentences.zh: 所以，当你在一个非常封闭的社会中创造了某种渠道时，各种事情都会发生，好的坏的都有。

sentences.en: I just think the phone has made it much easier.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得电话让这一切变得容易多了。

sentences.en: It's sort of creating a pipe.
sentences.zh: 它就像是在创造一根管道。

sentences.en: And anything can go through that pipe.
sentences.zh: 任何东西都可以通过这根管道。

sentences.en: Good things can go and bad things can go.
sentences.zh: 好的东西可以，坏的东西也可以。

sentences.en: The pipe itself is neutral.
sentences.zh: 管道本身是中性的。

sentences.en: The pipe doesn't care what goes through it.
sentences.zh: 管道不在乎通过它的是什么。

sentences.en: What happened when you reported this to the authorities?
sentences.zh: 当你向当局报告这件事时，发生了什么？

sentences.en: They were just like, don't worry.
sentences.zh: 他们只是说，别担心。

sentences.en: Like, the next time you call, just let it go to voicemail.
sentences.zh: 比如，下次他再打来，就让它转到语音信箱。

sentences.en: Just don't pick up.
sentences.zh: 别接就行了。

sentences.en: Apparently, he had called over 500 girls, if I'm not mistaken.
sentences.zh: 如果我没记错的话，他显然已经给500多个女孩打过电话了。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: One person.
sentences.zh: 一个人。

sentences.en: Something like that.
sentences.zh: 差不多是这样。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And he used to spend like two or three hours a day just calling in the hope of, you know, landing a conversation with someone.
sentences.zh: 他过去每天花两三个小时打电话，只是希望能和某人聊上一会儿。

sentences.en: I don't think it was with malicious intent.
sentences.zh: 我不认为他有什么恶意。

sentences.en: It was just to see if someone was out there for him.
sentences.zh: 他只是想看看有没有人愿意理他。

sentences.en: But yeah, I definitely wouldn't advise someone to do that if they're looking for love.
sentences.zh: 但说真的，如果有人在寻找爱情，我绝对不会建议他们这样做。

sentences.en: So it sounds like, despite this kind of harassment, you seem to understand why someone might do this, as kind of awful as it might feel.
sentences.zh: 所以听起来，尽管存在这种骚扰，你似乎能理解为什么有人会这样做，尽管这感觉很糟糕。

sentences.en: I do, but I don't agree with it at all.
sentences.zh: 我能理解，但我一点也不赞同。

sentences.en: I mean, yes, okay, you might not be very exposed to talking to girls.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，是的，好吧，你可能不太有机会和女孩说话。

sentences.en: And apparently this man, he was a very quiet guy and he's probably never spoken to a woman in his life, something like that.
sentences.zh: 显然这个男人是个非常内向的人，他这辈子可能都没和女人说过话，大概就是这样。

sentences.en: So maybe hiding behind a phone gave him more confidence.
sentences.zh: 所以躲在电话后面可能给了他更多的自信。

sentences.en: I don't really know.
sentences.zh: 我真的不知道。

sentences.en: I want to get an idea of the repercussions here.
sentences.zh: 我想了解一下这会带来什么后果。

sentences.en: What's at stake if a woman gets caught having these interactions with a man on her phone?
sentences.zh: 如果一个女人被发现和男人在电话里有这种互动，会有什么风险？

sentences.en: Well, there are lots of conservative communities, especially in the north of India, where young women aren't allowed to have phones at all.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有很多保守的社区，特别是在印度北部，那里的年轻女性根本不允许拥有手机。

sentences.en: And this is the reason, because they're afraid that as soon as the daughter gets a phone, she has a boyfriend.
sentences.zh: 原因就在于此，因为他们担心女儿一旦有了手机，就会交男朋友。

sentences.en: I mean, these things are just really associated very directly with one another.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这些事情确实是直接联系在一起的。

sentences.en: And if you look at the statistics in India, women have far less access to mobile phones than men.
sentences.zh: 如果你看看印度的统计数据，女性使用手机的机会远低于男性。

sentences.en: Ellen, what are the repercussions of having a boyfriend, not just a phone?
sentences.zh: 艾伦，交男朋友的后果是什么，不仅仅是拥有手机？

sentences.en: Well, it depends what kind of community you come from.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这取决于你来自什么样的社区。

sentences.en: I mean, you certainly hear, I mean, the catastrophic stories about honor killings and young couples
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你肯定听说过关于荣誉谋杀的灾难性故事，年轻情侣

sentences.en: who end up getting murdered by their, you know, cousins and brothers because it's an intercast relationship.
sentences.zh: 最终被他们的表亲或兄弟谋杀，因为那是跨种姓的恋爱。

sentences.en: I mean, those are out there.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这些事情确实存在。

sentences.en: But I think more often is probably the kind of thing that I heard about with the girls that I was following, which is they are kept under much more confining circumstances if
sentences.zh: 但我认为更常见的情况可能是我从我跟踪的那些女孩那里听到的，那就是如果她们被发现，

sentences.en: they're found out.
sentences.zh: 她们会被关在更受限制的环境中。

sentences.en: And I suppose it has some impact on their marriage ability because the girl is always sort of prepared from birth for a marriage market.
sentences.zh: 而且我想这会对她们的婚嫁产生影响，因为女孩从出生起就一直为婚姻市场做准备。

sentences.en: I mean, these are communities that are almost all arranged marriages, which are bargains between families.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这些社区几乎都是包办婚姻，是家庭之间的交易。

sentences.en: And if the girl is seen to have any kind of romantic or sexual experience, then her value is less.
sentences.zh: 如果女孩被认为有过任何浪漫或性经历，那么她的价值就会降低。

sentences.en: Where do you think this all comes from, what you're describing as the way that some men in
sentences.zh: 你认为这一切源于什么，也就是你所描述的印度一些男人对待女性的方式，以及他们在这个电话中对待你的方式？

sentences.en: India are treating women and you in this phone call?
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，我觉得在典型的印度社会中成长，男人和女人并不被视为平等。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, I feel like growing up in a typical, typical Indian society, men and women are not looked at as equals.
sentences.zh: 事情就是这么简单。

sentences.en: And it's as simple as that.
sentences.zh: 所以最后，回到警察呼叫中心。

sentences.en: So finally, back to the police call center.
sentences.zh: 我对警察在这一切中所扮演的角色很感兴趣，他们正在处理这些关切的电话。

sentences.en: I'm interested in the role of the police in all this, who are taking these calls of concern.
sentences.zh: 他们是在帮助保护这些女性，还是在帮助执行印度这些社会禁忌？

sentences.en: Are they helping to protect these women or are they helping to enforce these societal strictures in India?
sentences.zh: 在印度的许多不同场景中，这两件事是同时发生的。

sentences.en: Those two things happen at the same time in India in so many different scenarios.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，这些女性是在投诉骚扰，而且我认为，她们没有很好的手段来保护自己。

sentences.en: In this case, these are women who are complaining about harassment and who, I think, haven't had a very good means of defending themselves or protecting themselves.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这在这一点上是毫无疑问的好事。

sentences.en: So I think it's an unambiguous good there.
sentences.zh: 让我感到更模糊的是，他们现在派出的是“反罗密欧小队”，基本上就是发现情侣在一起就去盘问他们。

sentences.en: What is more ambiguous to me is that what they're sending out now is anti-Romeo squads that basically find couples that are together and interrogate them.
sentences.zh: 我猜这是基于一种假设，即男人在强迫女人，但我认为这更多是在限制女性拥有爱情生活的自由。

sentences.en: I suppose on the assumption that the man is somehow forcing himself on the woman, that I would put more on the side of constricting the women's freedom to have a love life.
sentences.zh: 艾伦，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Ellen, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常引人入胜的故事。

sentences.en: This is a really fascinating story.
sentences.zh: 好的，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Well, thank you.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的消息。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 北卡罗来纳州废除了一项限制跨性别者权利的争议性法律。

sentences.en: North Carolina has repealed a controversial law that restricted the rights of transgender people.
sentences.zh: 2016年的这项法律曾要求人们使用与出生证明上的性别相符的洗手间，而不是他们的性别认同。

sentences.en: The 2016 law had required people to use restrooms that match the sex of their birth certificates rather than their gender identity.
sentences.zh: 这引发了来自企业、艺人和体育联盟对北卡罗来纳州的抵制。

sentences.en: And it provoked boycotts of North Carolina from companies, entertainers and sports leagues.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们废除了第2号众议院法案，我们开始在北卡罗来纳州终结歧视。

sentences.en: Today, we repealed House Bill 2, and we began to end discrimination in North Carolina.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统正威胁要对那些破坏共和党医疗保健计划的众议院保守派进行政治报复，他在推特上承诺，当他们明年寻求连任时，他将开展竞选活动反对他们。

sentences.en: And President Trump is threatening political payback against House conservatives who derailed
sentences.zh: 我鼓励我们的成员做的是继续相互沟通，直到我们能达成共识通过这项法案，因为这是我们所有人都承诺要做的事情。

sentences.en: the Republican health care plan, promising in a tweet to campaign against them when they seek re-election next year.
sentences.zh: 所以他只是在表达他的沮丧。

sentences.en: What I am encouraging our members to do is keep talking with each other until we can get the consensus to pass this bill, because this is something we all said we would do.
sentences.zh: 你们都知道他在各种论坛上都会这样做，包括推特。

sentences.en: And so he is just expressing his frustration.
sentences.zh: 我理解他的沮丧。

sentences.en: You all know that he does that in various forums, including Twitter.
sentences.zh: 最后，我要感谢所有对昨天的节目做出回应的人。

sentences.en: And I understand his frustration.
sentences.zh: 这是我们迄今为止收到反馈最多的一期节目。

sentences.en: Finally, I want to thank all of you who responded to yesterday's show.
sentences.zh: 我们从讨论气候变化的科学开始，最后采访了一位煤矿工人，听他讲述自己的故事。

sentences.en: It was by far the most feedback we've received for an episode.
sentences.zh: 你们中的一些人写信说，非常感谢能听到那个视角。

sentences.en: We started by talking about the science of climate change and ended by talking to a coal miner about his story.
sentences.zh: 另一些人则认为我们没有用更多的科学知识来挑战那个视角。

sentences.en: Some of you wrote to say how much you appreciated hearing that perspective.
sentences.zh: 我们会继续倾听这里《每日新闻》听众的声音，包括你们。

sentences.en: Others felt we had not challenged that perspective with more of a science.
sentences.zh: 你可以发送电子邮件至thedaily@nytimes.com，或者在iTunes上给我们留下评论，让我们知道你的想法。

sentences.en: We'll keep listening to people here at The Daily, including you.
